Good afternoon, shoppers. Here are today's offers. All winter coats are thirty per cent off until closing time, which makes them cheaper than anything on our website. Remember that the price on the label does not include sales tax. Our two-year warranty is free with every laptop this week, and the extended one is the cheapest it has been all year. Keep your receipt: without it we cannot exchange anything after seven days. And there is no fee if you return an item in the same week.

This is your card provider with a short message about spending abroad. When you pay in dollars, we use the exchange rate of the day, and we add a fee of two per cent on every international purchase. Paying in the local currency is almost always better than letting the shop convert the amount for you, because the shop's rate is usually the worst one available. If you cannot afford a large purchase in one payment, call us before you travel and we will look at the options together.

First, Thiago found the same laptop in two stores on the same street. Then he compared the two labels and saw that one was fifty dollars cheaper. After that, he read the small print and found the restocking fee. Next, he asked the clerk about the warranty and the sales tax. Finally, he bought the more expensive one, because it was the better deal, and he kept the receipt.
